section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: Sex-wise distribution of number of persons involved in accidental deaths indicates that 62.4% of males were involved in accidents. Incidence of Accidental Deaths in States, Union Territories and Cities. Table 3 Presents incidence of accidental deaths in different States, Union Territories and cities during 1966 and 1967 along with percentage variation during 1967 over 1966. It may be observed that the State of Punjab indicated a very significant increase of 346.9% over 1966 while Jammu and Kashmir indicated a marked decline of 59.1%. Although there had been an over-all increase of 4.2% during 1967 in the country over 1966 yet it does not reflect similar variations in individual States and Union Territories which show marked deviations from the All-India trend. Some States and Union Territories reported increase while other indicated decline. TABLE-3 Comparative statement of incidence of accidental deaths in States, Union Territories and Cities during 1966 and 1967
